feedback: No Integrator race evidence exists yet, so this feedback rests on design reasoning only. For the symmetric five-sensor row, I built the controller with weights proportional to sensor x (sensor-position weighting), since that is the only signal shape the geometry supports at iteration 0. Nothing has been measured for this candidate. Next race: if the row saturates (readings all near 1 or all near 0) on tight bends, or line_loss_events cluster on specific bends, widen the row or move it forward as your intent describes. If steering_oscillation is high with a stable row, shorten wheel_track or lower mass before changing the sensor layout. Hold the current geometry if the race shows completion with few line-loss events on oval and s-bend.
requested_changes: Hold sensor_positions and sensor_size if the next race shows completion with few line_loss_events on the oval and s-bend, and check line_loss clustering on the slalom.
If saturation or dropout appears on tight bends, widen the row to about 0.024 m half-span (x = -0.024 to +0.024) or move it forward to y about 0.06 m, one change at a time.
If steering_oscillation is high while the sensor row is informative, try wheel_track 0.10 m or mass 0.6 kg to reduce yaw inertia.
